{{Top}}
[[File:Nightlife-slot-machine.jpg|thumb|right|240px|A Kingpin slot machine modified to display a Hutt's face on Nar Shaddaa]]
A '''slot machine''' was a gambling game popular in [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Star Cluster Casino|Star Cluster]] and [[Club Vertica Casino|Club Vertica]] casinos both used "[[Smugglers Luck slot machine|Smugglers Luck]]", "[[Kingpin slot machine|Kingpin]]", and "[[Emperor slot machine|Emperor]]" slot machines during nightlife events,<ref name="Star Cluster Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Star Cluster Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Club Vertica Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Club Vertica Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> including the [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Soovada]]. The [[Grande Game]] casino of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]]<ref name="CP">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref> and the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> had several slot machines. A number of slot machines could also be found at the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace of Jabba the Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
